summary: Tested new read-only evidence_feedback endpoints and the new 'AI Accuracy' tab on Team Themes. All 10 backend tests pass (stats math, list schema, limit cap, role gating 403 for attendee, unauth 401, date filters, regression on existing admin endpoints). Frontend AI Accuracy tab renders correctly showing 194 total reviewed / 99.3% acceptance / 1 rejected / 1 needs-follow-up / top rejected 'QS Effective 1 — Assessing needs' / 194 recent decision rows. Export CSV button downloads 'ai-accuracy-feedback.csv'. All 6 existing Team Themes tabs (matrix, themes, achievements, learning_needs, risks, actions) still render without console errors. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoints correctly use database.with_org() + explicit WHERE org_id=$1 for defense-in-depth, and explicit SELECT columns (no SELECT *), matching codebase convention.
Acceptance rate math verified: round((accepted/(accepted+rejected))*100, 1); returns null when no decided items — correct.
limit param properly capped at max(1, min(limit, 1000)); date_from/date_to filtering works.
Frontend AiAccuracyView uses cachedGet + cancel guard on unmount; export CSV done client-side (no extra endpoint) — sensible for 200-row cap.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite runs with `python -m pytest tests/test_evidence_feedback_readonly.py -o addopts=''` (must disable xdist because helper subprocess in fixture races under loadscope, causing SKIPs). All flows verified end-to-end with cookie injection at preview URL. Note: the automation quirk mentioned by main agent (login form fill trouble) was avoided by injecting supervision_access/supervision_refresh cookies directly via context.add_cookies — recommend this approach for future frontend tests on this app.
